definitions.explanation: the process of becoming old-fashioned, obsolete, or no longer useful due to advances in technology or changes in society

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陳腐化|ちんぷか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧。
⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陳腐化|ちんぷか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{計画的|けいかくてき}→計画的：21003_keikakuteki⟧{陳腐化|ちんぷか}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
{陳腐化|ちんぷか} refers to things becoming outdated or obsolete.

WRITING:
- {陳|ちん} (display, old)
- {腐|ふ} (rotten, stale)
- ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (-ization)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (technological obsolescence)
- ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (product obsolescence)
- ⟦{計画的|けいかくてき}→計画的：21003_keikakuteki⟧{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (planned obsolescence)
- {陳腐化|ちんぷか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (obsolescence countermeasures)

USAGE:
- {陳腐化|ちんぷか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become obsolete - suru verb)
- {陳腐化|ちんぷか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (obsolescence advances)

⟦{計画的|けいかくてき}→計画的：21003_keikakuteki⟧{陳腐化|ちんぷか} (planned obsolescence) refers to deliberately designing products to become outdated, encouraging consumers to buy new versions.
